words.zh: 代理機構（travel agency 旅行社）
按鈕（the power button 電源鍵）

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Good afternoon, and welcome to the hotel. Checking in?
scene.zh: 午安，歡迎光臨。要辦入住嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Hi, I have a reservation under Harbor Trading.
scene.zh: 你好，我有訂房，是用 Harbor Trading 的名字訂的。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Let me look. It was booked through a travel agency, right?
scene.zh: 我看一下。這是透過旅行社訂的，對吧？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Hmm, I only see one double room here.
scene.zh: 嗯，我這邊只看到一間雙人房。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: We booked two single rooms for three nights.
scene.zh: 我們訂了兩間單人房，住三個晚上。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Oh, you're right. We reserved two singles, Wednesday to Saturday.
scene.zh: 喔，您說得對。我們幫您保留了兩間單人房，星期三到星期六。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: They were paid in advance, so you're all set.
scene.zh: 房費已經事先付好了，這樣就完成了。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Here are your key cards. You're both on the fifth floor.
scene.zh: 這是你們的房卡。兩位都在五樓。

fills.en: Is breakfast ___ in the room rate?
fills.note: 早餐是「被包含」在房價裡：is＋included。

fills.en: Our hotel is very ___, so everything is close.
fills.zh: 我們飯店就在市中心，到哪裡都很近。
fills.note: 離哪裡都近，表示在市中心：central。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Each room has a private bathroom and a big television.
scene.zh: 每間房都有自己的浴室，還有一台大電視。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Is breakfast included in the room rate?
scene.zh: 房價有含早餐嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Yes, it is. We have it daily in the restaurant.
scene.zh: 有喔。每天都在餐廳供應。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: We also have a gym and a pool on the eighth floor.
scene.zh: 我們八樓還有健身房和游泳池。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: How late is the pool open?
scene.zh: 游泳池開到幾點？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Until ten every night. The bar is open later.
scene.zh: 每天開到晚上十點。酒吧開得比較晚。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: And the hotel is very central, so it's really convenient.
scene.zh: 而且飯店就在市中心，真的很方便。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: The train station is just across the street, too.
scene.zh: 電車站也就在對面。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: The key card you gave me doesn't work.
scene.zh: 你給我的房卡刷不開。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Sorry about that! The lock can be slow. Try this one.
scene.zh: 不好意思！那個鎖有時候比較慢。試試這張。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Welcome back. So, did the new card work?
scene.zh: 您回來了。新的卡可以用嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Sorry, but this isn't the room I booked.
scene.zh: 不好意思，這跟我訂的房間不一樣。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Oh no, you're right. That's a double, and it's still dirty.
scene.zh: 糟糕，您說得對。那是雙人房，而且還沒整理。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: And the air conditioner in that room is broken, too.
scene.zh: 而且那間的冷氣也壞了。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: I'm so sorry. Let me upgrade you to a suite.
scene.zh: 真的很抱歉。我幫您升等到套房。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: It's much more spacious, and there's no extra charge.
scene.zh: 套房寬敞很多，而且不用另外加錢。

passages.title: Welcome to Our Hotel
lines: Here is some information for your stay.
Internet: Complimentary and unlimited. Choose the wireless network "Guest". The password is your room number and your last name.
Breakfast: Complimentary, daily from 6:30 to 10:00 in the restaurant downstairs. You can also dine there in the evening until 9:30. The bar is open until midnight.
Laundry: Put your clothes in the laundry bag in the closet. Bring it to Reception before 9:00 a.m., and we will return it the same evening.
Pool and gym: Upstairs on the eighth floor, open daily from 6:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m. Extra towels for the shower are in the closet.

questions.en: What is the password for the wireless network?
questions.zh: 無線網路的密碼是什麼？

questions.en: By what time should you bring your laundry to Reception?
questions.zh: 送洗的衣服最晚幾點要拿到櫃台？

questions.en: Which place is open the latest?

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Hey, it's Dan. Did you read the card on the desk?
scene.zh: 嘿，我是 Dan。你看了桌上那張卡嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: I can't find the part about breakfast.
scene.zh: 我找不到講早餐的那一段。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Breakfast is downstairs from six thirty to ten.
scene.zh: 早餐在樓下，六點半到十點。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Great, thanks. And the wireless network is free and unlimited.
scene.zh: 太好了，謝啦。而且無線網路免費，還不限量。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Oh, and I want to swim before dinner.
scene.zh: 對了，我想在晚餐前去游個泳。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: How late is the pool open?
scene.zh: 游泳池開到幾點？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Until ten, I think. It's upstairs, next to the gym.
scene.zh: 我記得是到十點。在樓上，健身房旁邊。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Okay, see you in the lobby at six, then.
scene.zh: 好，那六點大廳見。

lines.en: My room is comfortable, but it's already a mess.
lines.zh: 我房間很舒服，可是已經亂成一團了。

lines.en: Mine too. Are you hungry? We could try the hotel bar.
lines.zh: 我的也是。你餓了嗎？我們可以去飯店的酒吧試試。

lines.en: Let's find a small place nearby instead. Just a quick bite, then back here to relax.
lines.zh: 我們去附近找間小店吧。簡單吃一點，然後回來放鬆。

lines.en: Sounds good. What time should we wake up tomorrow?
lines.zh: 好啊。明天我們要幾點起床？

lines.en: Around seven. Let's meet here in the lobby at 8:45.
lines.zh: 七點左右。八點四十五分在大廳這裡集合吧。

lines.en: The hotel shuttle can give us a ride. It starts at ten.
lines.zh: 飯店的接駁車可以載我們過去。十點開始。

lines.en: Okay. I'll see you here at 8:45.
lines.zh: 好。那八點四十五分這裡見。

lines.en: Great. Hopefully the traffic is okay in the morning.

questions.en: What time will they meet tomorrow?
How will they get there tomorrow?

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Hey! How's the new room? Is it comfortable?
scene.zh: 嘿！新房間怎麼樣？舒服嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: The internet connection in my room is really slow.
scene.zh: 我房間的網路超慢。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Mine too. I couldn't even send one email.
scene.zh: 我的也是。我連一封信都寄不出去。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Anyway, I'm really hungry. I didn't eat on the plane.
scene.zh: 先不管了，我好餓。我在飛機上都沒吃東西。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Do you want to get a bite to eat?
scene.zh: 要不要去吃點東西？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Sure! There's a little place nearby. Let's walk.
scene.zh: 好啊！附近有一間小店。我們走過去吧。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Then we can come back early and relax.
scene.zh: 吃完可以早點回來放鬆一下。

textFills.title: Laundry Service
lines: Need clean clothes? Our laundry service is open daily.
Put your clothes in the basket in your closet and call the front desk. A housekeeper will ___ them up.
We will wash, dry and ___ your shirts, and bring them back the same evening.
___ Ask at the front desk for the price list.
zh: 需要乾淨的衣服嗎？我們的洗衣服務每天都有。
把衣服放進衣櫃裡的籃子，再打電話給櫃台。房務人員會來收。
我們會幫您把襯衫洗好、弄乾、燙好，當天晚上送回。
這項服務不是免費的。價目表請向櫃台索取。

blanks.note: will 後面接原形動詞：will pick up。
洗好、弄乾以後，襯衫要燙：iron。
下一句說要看價目表，所以這項服務要收費。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: The iron stopped working while I was using it.
scene.zh: 熨斗用到一半就壞了。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Sorry! It turns off automatically. Try the power button again.
scene.zh: 不好意思！它會自動關掉。再按一次電源鍵試試。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: If it still doesn't work, we can wash your shirt for you.
scene.zh: 如果還是不行，我們可以幫您洗襯衫。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Could I get this shirt back by tomorrow morning?
scene.zh: 這件襯衫明天早上以前可以拿回來嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Sure. A housekeeper will knock and pick it up soon.
scene.zh: 沒問題。房務人員等一下會去敲門收衣服。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Oh, and someone called while you were out.
scene.zh: 對了，您出去的時候有人打電話來。

lines.en: Hi, it's Ms. Carter. I hope your flight was okay.
lines.zh: 嗨，我是 Carter。希望你們這趟飛行還順利。

lines.en: Mr. Hughes is flying in to see the fair.
lines.zh: Hughes 先生會飛過去看商展。

lines.en: He'd like to take you both to dinner on Saturday, after it closes.
lines.zh: 他想在星期六商展結束後，請你們兩個吃晚餐。

lines.en: So please extend your stay by one night and fly home on Sunday.
lines.zh: 所以請你們多住一晚，星期日再飛回來。

lines.en: Don't worry about the extra expense. You have my approval.
lines.zh: 多出來的費用不用擔心，我已經批准了。

lines.en: I checked, and the hotel is fully booked on Saturday, so ask the front desk about a cancellation.
lines.zh: 我查過了，飯店星期六客滿，所以請到櫃台問問有沒有人取消。

lines.en: If they don't have a room, find inexpensive accommodation nearby.
lines.zh: 如果他們沒有房間，就在附近找個不貴的地方住。

lines.en: Keep all your receipts. Ms. Reed will reimburse you when you're back.
lines.zh: 收據都要留著。你們回來以後，Reed 會把錢還給你們。

lines.en: And for meals, please don't exceed roughly sixty dollars a day. Thanks!
lines.zh: 還有餐費，一天大約不要超過六十塊。謝謝！

questions.en: Why should they stay one more night?
questions.zh: 他們為什麼要多住一晚？
options: To have dinner with Mr. Hughes
The fair is one day longer

questions.en: What should they do if the hotel has no room?
questions.zh: 飯店沒有房間的話，他們要怎麼做？

questions.en: About how much can they spend on meals each day?
questions.zh: 餐費一天大約可以花多少？

scene.speaker: npc

scene.zh: 又見面了。您聽過語音留言了嗎？

scene.en: Could we extend our stay by one more night?
scene.zh: 我們可以多住一晚嗎？
